title: growth_plan_demand modulo by terminal_spawn_interval_ticks has no zero-guard at the use site; direct Balance literals omitting the knob panic with divide-by-zero
detail: Zero interval passes no use-site check; only the loader guards it. Any growth-enabled run on a directly-constructed Balance (wire_path_test pattern) hits integer divide-by-zero. Contrast placement_valid's max(1, sep) in-code-literal guard.
recommended_fix: Guard at the use site like placement_valid: `iv := max(cat.balance.terminal_spawn_interval_ticks, 1)` before the modulo, or return early when the interval is 0.

title: New derived-bound formulas in demand_test divide by accrue with no zero floor; accrue == 0 is a state the same file and crisis_test explicitly create
evidence:
campus_cap_picks := W / ((1000 + u64(spawn_credit_accrue_milli(cat, camp_idx)) - 1) / u64(spawn_credit_accrue_milli(cat, camp_idx)))
--- :692 (W9 loop):
		eff := WINDOW / ((1000 + acc - 1) / acc)
--- same file, :407-409 (zero accrue demonstrated as a contemplated state):
	nt := &cat.node_types[res_idx]
	nt.throughput_units = 0
	testing.expect_value(t, spawn_credit_accrue_milli(cat, res_idx), u32(0))
detail: spawn_credit_accrue_milli returns 0 for zero-throughput types or cap_fraction_permille 0 (crisis_test sets it). A host/campus retuned to zero throughput panics these tests instead of failing them; production code floors at 1 (spawn_credit_max_milli).
recommended_fix: Floor the divisor like flow.odin does: `acc := max(u64(spawn_credit_accrue_milli(...)), 1)` at both :525 and the W9 loop, so degenerate catalogs fail the floor assertion, not crash.

title: packet_bandwidth (THE pace knob) still loads via lenient jint with silent default 30 — an absent key silently reverts the pace 4x with no load error
detail: jint returns the default when the key is missing; only invalid values fail-fast. balance.json is the user's fun-test iteration surface — dropping the pace key silently reverts 120→30 with no error at load.
recommended_fix: Load packet_bandwidth with jint_strict and the same presence-required >= 1 check the cadence knobs use, so a missing pace knob is a load error, not a silent 4x revert.
